visual_action: A slideshow of three screenshots from X (formerly Twitter). The first is a tweet from Amy Klobuchar showing her posing with four shirtless, muscular firefighters. The second is a tweet from Ilhan Omar posing with the same firefighters and another woman. The third is a tweet from Tina Smith showing her being held in the air by two of the firefighters. The setting for all photos appears to be an outdoor fair.

cast.name: Amy Klobuchar
cast.evidence: Her tweet, including her name, handle '@amyklobuchar', and a photo of her, is the first image shown in the video.

cast.name: Ilhan Omar
cast.evidence: Her tweet, including her name, handle '@IlhanMN', and a photo of her, is the second image shown in the video.

cast.name: Tina Smith
cast.evidence: Her tweet, including her name, handle '@TinaSmithMN', and a photo of her, is the third image shown in the video.

cast.name: Minnesota firefighters

cast.name: MNAFLCIO

on_screen_text.text: State Fair pro tip: You don't want to miss the Minnesota firefighters at the @MNAFLCIO.
Thanks for the pro tip Amy — they really swept me off my feet

audio_music: The video is set to upbeat, celebratory electronic dance music that switches to the iconic pop song 'Lay All Your Love On Me' by ABBA before switching back. The music creates a fun, lighthearted, and humorous tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow, transitioning between three static screenshots of tweets.

central_claim: Minnesota's female Democratic politicians (Klobuchar, Omar, Smith) are fun, relatable, and supportive of union labor, as shown by their lighthearted interactions with firefighters at the state fair.
intended_effect: To humanize the politicians and portray them in a positive, pro-union light, making them seem more personable and approachable to viewers.
